name: Hyrule Survivors: Savage Labyrinth
author: BeZide93
description: An experimental six-wave Survivors expedition in a separate copy of Savage Labyrinth floor 1. Automatic spirit weapons, EXP, upgrades, a champion and results. Tap the Survivors button during gameplay or press L + R + Minus.

options.name: Open Survivors
options.description: Switch on, then close the game menu to open the expedition screen. Switch off and on again to reopen it.
